| description = This fish can be found rarely in the waters of Rivervale. Its placeholders are very small fish [[a trout]] which have a very fast respawn time. The PH might also be [[a large piranha]]. The Chomper is also a very small sized fish like the trout are, except a pinkish color similar to the appearance of the small crimson sail fish found in Kedge Keep. They are so small that they do not have names/titles above their heads. It is recommended to use a target command such as 'Cycle nearest NPC' to easily find them, otherwise you might miss Chomper all together. If you can't find Chomper just keep swimming around the entire water killing all of the trout and large piranhas and eventually Chomper should appear.
